gloss: head clerk; manager (of a traditional shop or inn)

definitions.gloss: head clerk; manager (of a traditional shop or inn)
definitions.explanation: The senior employee who ran the business of an old merchant house, a ryokan or a bathhouse for the owner, above the clerks and apprentices. Today it survives in inns and, figuratively, for a leader's right-hand person who manages things.

examples.japanese: {番頭|ばんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The head clerk welcomed the guests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{番頭|ばんとう}さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I asked the inn's manager for directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{番頭|ばんとう}⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実務|じつむ}→実務：12307_jitsumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{仕切|しき}っている→取り仕切る：11946_torishikiru⟧。
examples.english: As the president's right-hand man, he runs the company's day-to-day business.

notes:
In the Edo-period merchant house a boy entered as ⟦{丁稚|でっち}→丁稚：32131_decchi⟧ (apprentice), rose to {手代|てだい} (clerk), and might become {番頭|ばんとう}, sometimes later opening a branch of his own (のれん{分|わ}け). Often said with さん: {番頭|ばんとう}さん.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{番頭|ばんとう}: the manager of an inn
- {大番頭|おおばんとう}: chief head clerk
- {番頭|ばんとう}⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧: a right-hand role, the person who manages things for the boss

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{女将|おかみ}→女将：12210_okami⟧: the proprietress of an inn or restaurant
- {支配人|しはいにん}: manager — the modern word for a hotel or theater manager
